ody.text: Chainer discovers the Mirari in a ruined manor's basement but resists its call, deciding it is fit only for the First of the Cabal, and he hands it over as a tournament prize.
He befriends Kamahl in the pits and the two form a twelve-win partnership, which is broken when Kamahl refuses the First's order to throw a match.
Chainer uses the Mirari to heal Kamahl and then to overthrow the Patriarch, exiling him to Aphetto and taking over the Cabal while dementia creatures overrun the city.
In a fight with Kamahl, the Mirari overloads him, he unleashes dementia horrors and dies, and he gives the Mirari to Kamahl.

tor.text: The Patriarch arranges the death of Chainer's teacher Skellum in a pit fight, and Chainer swears revenge.
To earn use of the Mirari, Chainer slaughters Teroh, his corps and the wounded and healers in a Samite hospital, and he makes Burke for Laquatus.
He uses the Mirari to power a Death Bloom that kills the Patriarch's guards, forces the Patriarch into exile in Aphetto and gives him control of Cabal City.

When an Order attack interrupts the Mirari games, he taps the dementia space of almost every caster on Otaria, and the Mirari overwhelms him in his fight with Kamahl, so that Chainer begs Kamahl to kill him, and the Mirari passes to Kamahl.
